setup_fastcsp_logger: create a centralized FastCSP logger with configurable file and console output handlers
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP project header banner with optional restart and stage information
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary as pretty-printed JSON to the FastCSP logger
log_stage_start: log the start of a workflow stage with an optional description message
log_error: log an exception with its type and full traceback in a standardized format
